resolution: The body/kids split was decisive: shell = body 0 + kids 130, so EditorShell's own render is free and the entire ~130ms is the child panels rendering before the loader pane — but they're STILL re-rendering despite the panel memos + buildingPrefabs/shownFocus stabilizations, so a prop is unstable somewhere (and Chrome + EditorLayout aren't memoized at all). To stop guessing prop-by-prop, added a render-counter: renderTick('Name') at the top of each suspect render (Chrome the shell bar, PropertiesPanel, RightPanel, CatalogRail) into the shared editLatency module, and the edit-latency line now appends 're-rendered: <names>' — the components that actually re-rendered for THAT edit (diffed against the prior snapshot). One place-click now names the exact culprits, so the next cut memoizes/stabilizes only those instead of guessing. Cart-side, hot-reloads. Sha 17e66f8ed. NOTE: this commit adds diagnostic renderTick calls to 4 components + the editLatency module; they're cheap counters to be removed once the perf work lands.
